components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The compact teal call to action used for the strongest next step.
components.html: View my work
components.css: .ds-primary-action { display:inline-flex; min-height:50px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; padding:13px 18px; border:1px solid var(--accent); border-radius:8px; background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-contrast); font:620 14px/1.2 var(--font-geist),sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),background 180ms ease; } .ds-primary-action svg { width:16px; height:16px; } .ds-primary-action:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 88%,var(--ink)); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-primary-action:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: A quieter underlined action for contact and external navigation.
components.html: Get in touch
components.css: .ds-text-action { display:inline-flex; min-height:46px; align-items:center; gap:8px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-strong); color:var(--ink); font:580 14px/1.2 var(--font-geist),sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:color 180ms ease,border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-text-action svg { width:16px; height:16px; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-text-action:hover { border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--accent); } .ds-text-action:hover svg { transform:translate(3px,-3px); } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Technology Chip
components.description: A non-interactive machine label for technologies used in context.
components.css: .ds-technology-chip { display:inline-block; padding:6px 9px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:5px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink-secondary); font:500 9px/1.3 var(--font-geist-mono),monospace; letter-spacing:0.02em; transition:border-color 180ms ease,background 180ms ease; } .ds-technology-chip:hover { border-color:var(--line-strong); background:var(--surface-soft); }

components.name: Circular Theme Control
components.description: A 42px circular utility control for theme switching.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-control" type="button" aria-label="Toggle color theme"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.93 4.93l1.42 1.42M17.66 17.66l1.41 1.41M2 12h2M20 12h2M4.93 19.07l1.42-1.42M17.66 6.34l1.41-1.41"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-control { display:grid; width:42px; height:42px; place-items:center; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:50%; background:transparent; color:var(--ink); cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms ease,border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-theme-control svg { width:16px; height:16px; } .ds-theme-control:hover { border-color:var(--line-strong); background:var(--surface-soft); } .ds-theme-control:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: A restrained horizontal navigation whose links yield to the page content.
components.html: WorkAboutStackContact
components.css: .ds-navigation { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:30px; font:400 14px/1.2 var(--font-geist),sans-serif; } .ds-navigation a { min-height:40px; align-content:center; color:var(--ink-secondary); text-decoration:none; transition:color 180ms ease; } .ds-navigation a:hover { color:var(--accent); } .ds-navigation a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: System Node
components.description: The signature topology node for products, operations, backend, APIs, and data.
components.css: .ds-system-node { display:flex; width:126px; min-height:70px; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:7px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:0 12px 28px -22px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 38%,transparent); } .ds-system-node span { margin-bottom:6px; color:var(--accent); font:500 7px/1.3 var(--font-geist-mono),monospace; letter-spacing:0.08em; } .ds-system-node strong { font:600 11px/1.3 var(--font-geist-mono),monospace; letter-spacing:0.06em; } .ds-system-node small { margin-top:3px; color:var(--ink-muted); font:400 9px/1.3 var(--font-geist),sans-serif; }

components.name: Section Rule Header
components.description: A fine-rule section opening that pairs a large title with concise context.
components.html:
Experience

The work behind the stack: systems, responsibilities, and problems solved.
components.css: .ds-section-header { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,7fr) minmax(260px,5fr); gap:48px; align-items:end; padding-top:26px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--ink); } .ds-section-header h2 { margin:0; font:520 clamp(2.6rem,5vw,4.75rem)/1 var(--font-geist),sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.04em; } .ds-section-header p { max-width:520px; margin:0 0 5px; color:var(--ink-secondary); font:400 15px/1.6 var(--font-geist),sans-serif; }

components.name: Current Status Register
components.description: A ruled evidence register for current role, location, and focus.
components.css: .ds-status-register { display:grid; min-height:112px; align-content:center; padding:24px 34px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); } .ds-status-register span,.ds-status-register small { color:var(--ink-muted); font:400 10px/1.3 var(--font-geist-mono),monospace; } .ds-status-register span { margin-bottom:8px; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-status-register strong { margin-bottom:4px; font:600 14px/1.3 var(--font-geist),sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio is a warm, editorial systems record: calm paper, near-black ink, fine rules, and sparse teal signals organize real evidence without turning it into a résumé dashboard. Its density comes from traces, registers, system nodes, and large project chapters rather than generic cards or ornamental decoration.

The world combines a human reading rhythm with the precision of an observability viewer. Large Geist headlines state the story directly; Geist Mono appears only where content behaves like metadata, status, sequence, time, or machine output. Light and dark modes swap semantic roles without changing hierarchy, and real product imagery is framed as evidence inside authored technical compositions.
keyCharacteristics: Asymmetric 7/5 desktop compositions that collapse into one clear reading column.
Warm neutral surfaces structured by one-pixel rules and restrained tonal separation.
Deep teal reserved for actions, active system nodes, status, and trace markers.
Large variable-weight grotesk headlines paired with compact machine metadata.
Real project imagery presented through booking, phone, window, and delivery-trace frames.
Brief, purposeful motion with a complete reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: The Sparse Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal identifies action, status, sequence, or system focus; it does not become a decorative field across ordinary content.

rules.name: The Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: Dark mode swaps the paper, surface, ink, rule, and accent roles together; component hierarchy and accent rarity remain unchanged.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Geist speaks to people; Geist Mono speaks for the system. Do not set ordinary prose or display headlines in mono.

rules.name: The Tight-Scale Rule
rules.body: Large headings use negative tracking and near-solid line height; body copy restores open leading for legibility.

rules.name: The Reading-Order Rule
rules.body: Responsive collapse always preserves narrative before visual evidence, even when desktop chapters alternate.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: A shadow must explain an overlap or floating layer; ordinary sections, lists, and resting actions remain flat.

rules.name: The Softened-Technical Rule
rules.body: Use small radii to make technical panels approachable, but do not turn content regions into pill-shaped containers.

rules.name: The Circle-With-Purpose Rule
rules.body: Circular geometry is reserved for controls, identity marks, trace points, status, and diagram flow.

dos: **Do** use teal only for actions, system state, sequence, and focus.
**Do** structure dense evidence with fine rules, trace markers, and aligned registers.
**Do** keep body copy comfortably led and constrained while headings stay tight and direct.
**Do** use real project imagery inside an authored evidence frame with accurate alternative text.
**Do** preserve semantic theme roles, visible keyboard focus, touch-sized controls, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: **Don't** turn project chapters, experience entries, or toolbox groups into generic floating cards.
**Don't** use Geist Mono for ordinary prose or expressive display copy.
**Don't** add decorative shadows, neon effects, logo walls, skill percentages, or excessive animation.
**Don't** import a project's local brand palette into the portfolio's global token system.
**Don't** hide or horizontally scroll core evidence on narrow screens; simplify and stack it.
